name: 28216-prefillheavy-dsv4flashfp8-tp8
model: sgl-project/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8. Ungated; ~294 GB of block-FP8 safetensors, not in the local HF cache, so it downloads once before the first run. On H100 this repackaged FP8 build is the variant that supports the declared topology; the stock FP4 checkpoint is tensor-parallel only.
hardware: 8x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node. No router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: tp8 with dp8 data-parallel attention on one node: eight attention replicas, one per card, over a MoE whose 256 routed experts are tensor-sharded across the same eight cards. ep1 with no all-to-all MoE backend, pp1. ~36.8 GB of weights per card.
architecture: DeepseekV4ForCausalLM, 284B total / 13B active Mixture-of-Experts: 43 layers, hidden 4096, MLA-compressed KV with DeepSeek sparse attention, 256 routed experts at top-6 plus 1 shared, block-FP8 weights and bf16 elsewhere. The rest is readable off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 1024 requests with a 2400 s safety cap -- four closed-loop rounds of 256, the first discarded.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no shared prefix and no prefix reuse: ~7373 prompt tokens in (stdev 473, clipped to 6554-8192) and ~922 output tokens out (stdev 59, clipped to 819-1024), a uniform spread over [0.8L, L] at L=8192 in and L=1024 out. `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`, seed 42, so every request produces its full output length.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant on a 284-billion-parameter sparse model, serving 256 concurrent eight-thousand-token requests across eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang server arguments. Engine version and commit are in configs/setupcard.md.

model-path: sgl-project/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8

trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 8
dp-size: 8
enable-dp-attention: true

kv-cache-dtype: fp8_e4m3

# Under DP attention this is a GLOBAL budget that the engine divides by dp-size, so it is 16384
# tokens per card and not 131072.
chunked-prefill-size: 131072

disable-radix-cache: true

enable-prefill-delayer: true
prefill-delayer-max-delay-ms: 5000

# HAZARD: well under stock, or an 80 GB card hits a CUDA OOM in the MoE on the first full prefill
# wave: a 131072-token global chunk needs ~11 GB of activation buffers outside the static budget.
mem-fraction-static: 0.70
